# Civitatis

> > Civitatis is a global travel booking platform offering airport transfers, tours, and activities in destinations worldwide.

Civitatis specializes in connecting travelers with local transportation services and experiences. The platform provides transfer services from major airports like Porto Seguro (BPS) and Bariloche (BRC) to popular tourist destinations including Caraíva, Villa La Angostura, and surrounding areas in Brazil and Argentina.

## Key Topics

- Civitatis
- Airport transfers (traslados)
- Porto Seguro (BPS)
- Bariloche (BRC)
- Caraíva
- Villa La Angostura
- Private and shared transportation
- Hotel transfer services
- Trancoso
- Arraial d'Ajuda
- Llao Llao
- Santa Cruz Cabrália
- Travel booking platform
- Tourist transportation

## Airport Transfer Services

- [Traslados en Caraíva - Servicio de transfer aeropuerto hotel](https://www.civitatis.com/es/caraiva/traslados): Airport transfer service from Porto Seguro (BPS) to Caraíva hotels
- [Traslados en Villa La Angostura - Servicio de transfer aeropuerto hotel](https://www.civitatis.com/es/villa-la-angostura/traslados): Airport transfer service from Bariloche (BRC) to Villa La Angostura
